## 1. Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(grid)
library(here)

source(here('scripts', 'src', 'SIR_sim_func.R'))
source(here('scripts', 'src', 'SIR_sim_plot_func.R'))

plot_path = here('output')
rds_path = here('data', 'processed')

cm = 1 / 2.54
```

## 2. Import SIR Result Data

```{r import SIR data}
# Baseline (R0=2.5)
res_er_b = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'res_er_r0_25.rds'))
res_m1_b = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'res_m1_r0_25.rds'))
res_m2_b = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'res_m2_r0_25.rds'))

# Intervention (School Closure)
res_er_i = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'res_er_interv_r0_25.rds'))
res_m1_i = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'res_m1_interv_r0_25.rds'))
res_m2_i = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'res_m2_interv_r0_25.rds'))
```

## 3. Core Grob Function for Network Metrics

```{r core function}
create_network_metric_grob = function(sim_results_list, metric_col, title, y_max, y_label, period = 150, I_threshold = 5) {
  
  num_simulations = length(sim_results_list)
  
  main_vp = plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1), name = "main_vp")
  
  title_grob = textGrob(title, y = unit(1, 'npc') - unit(0.75, 'lines'))
  xlab_grob  = textGrob('Time (days)', y = unit(-2.5, 'lines'))
  ylab_grob  = textGrob(y_label, x = unit(-3, 'lines'), rot = 90)
  
  data_vp_off = dataViewport(xData = c(0, period), yData = c(0, y_max), extension = 0, name = "data_vp_off", clip = "off")
  
  bg = rectGrob(gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "black"))
  x_axis = xaxisGrob(at = seq(0, period, by = 30))
  
  if (y_max > 10) {
    
    y_ticks_only = yaxisGrob(at = seq(0, y_max, by = 5), label = FALSE)
    
    y_labels     = yaxisGrob(at = seq(0, y_max, by = 10), label = TRUE)

    y_axis = gTree(children = gList(y_ticks_only, y_labels))
  } else {
    y_breaks = seq(0, y_max, by = 0.2)
    y_axis = yaxisGrob(at = y_breaks)
  }
  
  axis_tree = gTree(children = gList(x_axis, y_axis), vp = data_vp_off)
  border_tree = gTree(children = gList(bg), vp = data_vp_off) 
  
  data_vp_on = dataViewport(xData = c(0, period), yData = c(0, y_max), extension = 0, name = "data_vp_on", clip = "on")
  
  line_grobs = list()
  for (i in 1:num_simulations) {
    res = sim_results_list[[i]]
    valid_idx = !is.na(res[[metric_col]])
    
    if (any(valid_idx)) {
      line_grobs[[i]] = linesGrob(
        x = res$time[valid_idx], 
        y = res[[metric_col]][valid_idx], 
        default.units = "native", 
        gp = gpar(col = "gray80", alpha = 0.2, lwd = 1.0) 
      )
    }
  }
  
  all_res_df = bind_rows(sim_results_list)
  mean_df = all_res_df %>%
    group_by(time) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = mean(.data[[metric_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_I   = mean(I, na.rm = TRUE), 
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean_val))
    
  if (any(mean_df$mean_I < I_threshold)) {
    cutoff_time = min(mean_df$time[mean_df$mean_I < I_threshold])
    mean_df = mean_df %>% filter(time < cutoff_time)
  }
    
  mean_line = linesGrob(
    x = mean_df$time,
    y = mean_df$mean_val,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(col = "steelblue", lwd = 2.5) 
  )
  
  clipped_lines_tree = gTree(children = do.call(gList, c(line_grobs, list(mean_line))), vp = data_vp_on)
  
  data_components = gList(axis_tree, clipped_lines_tree, border_tree)
  
  final_grob = gTree(children = gList(title_grob, xlab_grob, ylab_grob, data_components), vp = main_vp)
  return(final_grob)
}

create_network_legend_grob = function() {
  

  leg_bg = rectGrob(gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "black", lwd = 1))
  

  leg_sim_line = linesGrob(x = c(0.1, 0.25), y = 0.7, gp = gpar(col = "gray50", lwd = 2.5))
  leg_sim_text = textGrob("Simulation", x = 0.35, y = 0.7, just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 9))
  
  leg_mean_line = linesGrob(x = c(0.1, 0.25), y = 0.3, gp = gpar(col = "steelblue", lwd = 2.5))
  leg_mean_text = textGrob("Mean", x = 0.35, y = 0.3, just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 9))
  
  legend_tree = gTree(
    children = gList(leg_bg, leg_sim_line, leg_sim_text, leg_mean_line, leg_mean_text),
    name = "network_legend_grob"
  )
  
  return(legend_tree)
}

save_3x2_comparison = function(filename, baseline_list, intervention_list, metric_col = "avg_contacts_per_new_case", y_max, y_label) {
  pdf(filename, width = 16 * cm, height = 24 * cm, pointsize = 10)
    grid.newpage()
    lo = grid.layout(nrow = 3, ncol = 2, heights = unit(c(1, 1, 1), "null"), widths = unit(c(1, 1), "null"))
    pushViewport(viewport(layout = lo))
    
    model_names = c("Erdos-Renyi", "Model 1", "Model 2")
    
    for(i in 1:3) {
      # Baseline (Left)
      pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = i, layout.pos.col = 1))
        g = create_network_metric_grob(baseline_list[[i]], metric_col, paste0(model_names[i], " (Baseline)"), y_max, y_label)
        grid.draw(g)
      popViewport()
      
      # Intervention (Right)
      pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = i, layout.pos.col = 2))
        g_i = create_network_metric_grob(intervention_list[[i]], metric_col, paste0(model_names[i], " (Intervention)"), y_max, y_label)
        grid.draw(g_i)
      popViewport()
    }
    
    # Add Lengend
    if (metric_col == "avg_contacts_per_new_case") {
      pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
        pushViewport(plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1)))
          pushViewport(viewport(x = 11.5 / 15, y = 0.75,
                                just = c("center", "center"),
                                width = 7 / 15, height = 0.15))
            grid.draw(create_network_legend_grob())
          popViewport()
        popViewport()
      popViewport()
    } else {
      pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
        pushViewport(plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1)))
          pushViewport(viewport(x = 11.5 / 15, y = 5 / 12,
                                just = c("center", "center"),
                                width = 7 / 15, height = 0.15))
            grid.draw(create_network_legend_grob())
          popViewport()
        popViewport()
      popViewport()
    }

    
    popViewport()
  dev.off()
}
```

## 4. Generate Grobs

```{r generate grob}
zoom_y_max = 40
pct_y_max  = 1.2

# --- 1. Mean Contacts per New Infection ---
grob_avg_er   = create_network_metric_grob(res_er_r0_25, "avg_contacts_per_new_case", "Erdos-Renyi", zoom_y_max, "Mean Contacts per New I")
grob_avg_m1   = create_network_metric_grob(res_m1_r0_25, "avg_contacts_per_new_case", "Model 1", zoom_y_max, "Mean Contacts per New I")
grob_avg_m2   = create_network_metric_grob(res_m2_r0_25, "avg_contacts_per_new_case", "Model 2", zoom_y_max, "Mean Contacts per New I")
grob_avg_m2_i = create_network_metric_grob(res_m2_interv_r0_25, "avg_contacts_per_new_case", "Model 2 (Intervention)", zoom_y_max, "Mean Contacts per New I")

# --- 2. Local Saturation ---
grob_pct_er   = create_network_metric_grob(res_er_r0_25, "pct_contacts_infected", "Erdos-Renyi", pct_y_max, "Proportion of Contacts Infected")
grob_pct_m1   = create_network_metric_grob(res_m1_r0_25, "pct_contacts_infected", "Model 1", pct_y_max, "Proportion of Contacts Infected")
grob_pct_m2   = create_network_metric_grob(res_m2_r0_25, "pct_contacts_infected", "Model 2", pct_y_max, "Proportion of Contacts Infected")
grob_pct_m2_i = create_network_metric_grob(res_m2_interv_r0_25, "pct_contacts_infected", "Model 2 (Intervention)", pct_y_max, "Proportion of Contacts Infected")
```

## 5. 3x2 Baseline Comparison

```{r save the plot}
plot_loc_3x2 = here(plot_path, 'network_metrics_baseline_3x2.pdf')

pdf(plot_loc_3x2, width = 16 * cm, height = 24 * cm, pointsize = 10)

  grid.newpage()
  lo = grid.layout(nrow = 3, ncol = 2, 
                   heights = unit(c(1, 1, 1), c("null", "null", "null")),
                   widths = unit(c(1, 1), c("null", "null")))
  pushViewport(viewport(layout = lo))
  
    # Row 1: ER
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
      grid.draw(grob_avg_er)
    popViewport()
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 2))
      grid.draw(grob_pct_er)
    popViewport()
    
    # Row 2: Model 1
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1))
      grid.draw(grob_avg_m1)
    popViewport()
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 2))
      grid.draw(grob_pct_m1)
    popViewport()

    # Row 3: Model 2
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 3, layout.pos.col = 1))
      grid.draw(grob_avg_m2)
    popViewport()
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 3, layout.pos.col = 2))
      grid.draw(grob_pct_m2)
    popViewport()
    
    # Add Lengend
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
      pushViewport(plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1)))
        pushViewport(viewport(x = 11.5 / 15, y = 0.75, just = c("center", "center"),
                              width = 7 / 15, height = 0.15))
          grid.draw(create_network_legend_grob())
        popViewport()
      popViewport()
    popViewport()

  popViewport()

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Figure 1: Mean Contacts Comparison
save_3x2_comparison(
  filename = here(plot_path, 'mean_contacts_comparison_3x2.pdf'),
  baseline_list = list(res_er_b, res_m1_b, res_m2_b),
  intervention_list = list(res_er_i, res_m1_i, res_m2_i),
  metric_col = "avg_contacts_per_new_case",
  y_max = 40,
  y_label = "Mean Contacts per New I"
)

# Figure 2: Local Saturation Comparison
save_3x2_comparison(
  filename = here(plot_path, 'local_saturation_comparison_3x2.pdf'),
  baseline_list = list(res_er_b, res_m1_b, res_m2_b),
  intervention_list = list(res_er_i, res_m1_i, res_m2_i),
  metric_col = "pct_contacts_infected",
  y_max = 1.2,
  y_label = "Proportion of Contacts Infected"
)
```

## 7. Horizontal Plot

```{r}
save_2x3_comparison = function(filename, baseline_list, intervention_list, metric_col = "avg_contacts_per_new_case", y_max, y_label) {
  pdf(filename, width = 24 * cm, height = 16 * cm, pointsize = 10)
    grid.newpage()
    lo = grid.layout(nrow = 2, ncol = 3, heights = unit(c(1, 1), "null"), widths = unit(c(1, 1, 1), "null"))
    pushViewport(viewport(layout = lo))
    
    model_names = c("Erdos-Renyi", "Model 1", "Model 2")
    
    for(i in 1:3) {
      # Baseline (Top: row=1)
      pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = i))
        g = create_network_metric_grob(baseline_list[[i]], metric_col, paste0(model_names[i], " (Baseline)"), y_max, y_label)
        grid.draw(g)
      popViewport()
      
      # Intervention (Bottom: row=2)
      pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = i))
        g_i = create_network_metric_grob(intervention_list[[i]], metric_col, paste0(model_names[i], " (Intervention)"), y_max, y_label)
        grid.draw(g_i)
      popViewport()
    }
    
    # Add Legend (Erdos-Renyi Baselineに重ねる)
    if (metric_col == "avg_contacts_per_new_case") {
      pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
        pushViewport(plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1)))
          pushViewport(viewport(x = 11.5 / 15, y = 0.75,
                                just = c("center", "center"),
                                width = 7 / 15, height = 0.15))
            grid.draw(create_network_legend_grob())
          popViewport()
        popViewport()
      popViewport()
    } else {
      pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
        pushViewport(plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1)))
          pushViewport(viewport(x = 11.5 / 15, y = 5 / 12,
                                just = c("center", "center"),
                                width = 7 / 15, height = 0.15))
            grid.draw(create_network_legend_grob())
          popViewport()
        popViewport()
      popViewport()
    }

    popViewport()
  dev.off()
}
```
